observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Outdoor public road and stage during a community event with banners against crime and abuse
observation.dancers: Large group of men and boys of varying ages, dressed in casual or semi-formal vintage-style outfits, performing in procession and on a stage
observation.formation_and_space: Initially in a marching procession along a paved road carrying banners, transitioning to individual and group performance on an elevated outdoor stage
observation.posture: Upright torso, relaxed knees with frequent deep knee bends and high kicks
observation.footwork: Bouncy stepping, high knee lifts, quick shuffles and slides, synchronized marching steps on the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: Swinging naturally by the sides, gesturing, holding props such as walking sticks, briefcases, and banners
observation.hips_and_torso: Fluid motion with occasional bends and hip movement following the rhythm
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent jumps, high knee kicks, low crouches, and quick turns
observation.costume_and_props: Vintage-style clothing including trousers, button-down shirts, caps, suspenders, suits, white sneakers; props include walking sticks, briefcases, and banners reading 'Botswana Pantsulas Association'
observation.cannot_infer: Low resolution sampled frames obscure exact weight transfer and intricate foot speed.
